Marine Telemetry Project: Coral Reef Acoustic Observation

Acoustic sensor pods deployed along coastal reefs monitor fish migration traffic patterns and tidal currents.
Sensor mesh relays underwater hydrophone data across tidal channels to edge collector floats anchored in deep water.
Autonomous worker pods of underwater drones inspect coral health and upload acoustic telemetry to the surface receiver port.
Tidal ingress currents through the barrier reef affect acoustic wave dispersion during heavy monsoon seasons.
